title: Prediction of treatment success of dialectical behavior therapy in borderline personality disorder
summary: The study aim is to enable a better prediction which patients benefit most from a specific therapy of their Borderline personality disorder. To this end, so called biological markers will be determined including brain imaging as well as taking blood samples for genetic analysis.

interventions.name: 150 patients with Borderline-Personality disorder receive DBT-treatment. Efficacy of treatment will be asssessed using rating scales including the Zanarini rating scale for Borderline personality disorder and Borderline-symptom list 23. In addition biological data using imaging and genetics will be

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Borderline Personality Disorder F60.31
Exclusion criteria:
Intensive experience with DBT skills training, History of brain injury, epilepsy, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, subtstance abuse disorder during the last year. Current use of illegal drugs, current major depression, current use of benzodiazepines, general exclusion criteria for MRI (e.g. metal implants, pace maker)
